description: This Java class, ProjectResourceMapper, provides static methods to convert between Project domain objects and ProjectResource REST representations, facilitating data transfer in REST APIs.

classes.name: ProjectResourceMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to map between ProjectResource and Project objects.

methods.name: mapToProject
methods.description: Converts a ProjectResource REST resource to a Project domain model.

methods.name: mapToProjectResource
methods.description: Converts a Project domain model to a ProjectResource REST resource.

methods.name: mapToProjects
methods.description: Converts a list of ProjectResource objects to a set of Project domain models.

methods.name: mapToProjectResources
methods.description: Converts a set of Project domain models to a list of ProjectResource objects.
